title: Noctua Fan Inside a Mouse?

author: ShortCircuit
description:
Check out the Noctua Feinmann F01 at https://www.noctua.at/en/products/pulsar-feinmann-f01-noctua-edition

The Noctua Fineman FO1 puts a Noctua fan inside Pulsar’s lightweight gaming mouse design, aiming to keep sweaty palms cool without sacrificing the rest of the mouse experience. We go hands-on with its 73 g design, 8,000 Hz polling, optical switches, software, fan controls, and gaming performance in Resident Evil 4, CS2, and Apex Legends.
